result.instructions: Tools for StatusCake, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes StatusCake data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run statuscake_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run statuscake_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run statuscake_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. statuscake_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: statuscake_list_uptime_checks
tools.title: List uptime checks
tools.description: List uptime checks with their current status (up/down), type, URL, check rate, tags and uptime percentage. Filter by status or tags. StatusCake: GET /uptime.

status.description: Only checks currently in this state.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags; only checks carrying these tags are returned.

matchany.description: With tags: return checks matching ANY of the tags instead of ALL of them.

nouptime.description: Skip calculating uptime percentages (faster for large accounts).

tools.name: statuscake_get_uptime_check
tools.title: Get one uptime check
tools.description: Fetch one uptime check in full — settings, current status, last test time, next location and the monitoring servers it runs on. StatusCake: GET /uptime/{test_id}.

tools.name: statuscake_get_uptime_history
tools.title: Get uptime check history
tools.description: Individual test runs for one uptime check — when, from which location, the status code and the response time (ms). Newest first; follow links.next (or pass before) to page back. StatusCake: GET /uptime/{test_id}/history.

before.description: Only results before this UNIX timestamp (seconds). Use it with links.next to page back in time.

after.description: Only results after this UNIX timestamp (seconds).

tools.name: statuscake_get_uptime_periods
tools.title: Get uptime check up/down periods
tools.description: The up and down periods of one uptime check — when each started and ended and how long it lasted (ms). The direct answer to 'how long was it down?'. StatusCake: GET /uptime/{test_id}/periods.

before.description: Only results before this UNIX timestamp (seconds). Use it with links.next to page back in time.

after.description: Only results after this UNIX timestamp (seconds).

tools.name: statuscake_list_uptime_alerts
tools.title: List uptime check alerts
tools.description: Alerts triggered by one uptime check — when, the status it changed to and the status code. StatusCake: GET /uptime/{test_id}/alerts.

before.description: Only results before this UNIX timestamp (seconds). Use it with links.next to page back in time.

after.description: Only results after this UNIX timestamp (seconds).

tools.name: statuscake_list_ssl_checks
tools.title: List SSL checks
tools.description: List SSL certificate checks with the certificate's validity window (valid_from/valid_until), issuer, cipher and score, and flags such as expired, broken, revoked or mixed content. StatusCake: GET /ssl.

tools.name: statuscake_get_ssl_check
tools.title: Get one SSL check
tools.description: Fetch one SSL certificate check in full — expiry, issuer, cipher, scores, flags and any mixed-content resources found. StatusCake: GET /ssl/{test_id}.

tools.name: statuscake_list_pagespeed_checks
tools.title: List pagespeed checks
tools.description: List pagespeed checks with their location, alert thresholds and latest stats (load time ms, page size kb, request count, latest issue). StatusCake: GET /pagespeed.

tools.name: statuscake_get_pagespeed_history
tools.title: Get pagespeed check history
tools.description: Past runs of one pagespeed check — load time (ms), file size (kb), request count, throttling and the saved HAR file location. StatusCake: GET /pagespeed/{test_id}/history.

before.description: Only results before this UNIX timestamp (seconds). Use it with links.next to page back in time.

after.description: Only results after this UNIX timestamp (seconds).

tools.name: statuscake_list_heartbeat_checks
tools.title: List heartbeat checks
tools.description: List heartbeat (push) checks — jobs that must ping a StatusCake URL within a period — with their status, period and ping URL. StatusCake: GET /heartbeat.

status.description: Only checks currently in this state.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags; only checks carrying these tags are returned.

matchany.description: With tags: return checks matching ANY of the tags instead of ALL of them.

nouptime.description: Skip calculating uptime percentages (faster for large accounts).

tools.name: statuscake_get_heartbeat_check
tools.title: Get one heartbeat check
tools.description: Fetch one heartbeat check in full, including its ping URL, period, status and when it last received a ping. StatusCake: GET /heartbeat/{test_id}.

tools.name: statuscake_list_contact_groups
tools.title: List contact groups
tools.description: List contact groups — who gets alerted: email addresses, mobile numbers, integration ids and ping URL. Use their ids in a check's contact_groups. StatusCake: GET /contact-groups.

tools.name: statuscake_list_maintenance_windows
tools.title: List maintenance windows
tools.description: List maintenance windows (scheduled alert silences) with their start/end, timezone, repeat interval, state and the checks or tags they cover. Only works on accounts using the newer maintenance-windows feature. StatusCake: GET /maintenance-windows.

tools.name: statuscake_get_maintenance_window
tools.title: Get one maintenance window
tools.description: Fetch one maintenance window by id. StatusCake: GET /maintenance-windows/{window_id}.

tools.name: statuscake_list_uptime_locations
tools.title: List uptime monitoring locations
tools.description: List StatusCake's uptime monitoring servers — region, region code, IPv4/IPv6 and status. Use region codes in a check's regions; use the IPs for firewall allowlists. StatusCake: GET /uptime-locations.

region_code.description: Only servers in this region code.

tools.name: statuscake_list_pagespeed_locations
tools.title: List pagespeed monitoring locations
tools.description: List StatusCake's pagespeed monitoring servers — region, IPs and status. StatusCake: GET /pagespeed-locations.

location.description: Only servers in this country, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. GB.

tools.name: statuscake_create_uptime_check
tools.title: Create an uptime check
tools.description: Start monitoring a URL, host or IP. Returns the new check's id as data.new_id. Faster check rates and some regions depend on the plan. StatusCake: POST /uptime.

test_type.description: Check type: HTTP, HEAD, TCP, DNS, SMTP, SSH or PING.

website_url.description: URL, FQDN or IP address to check.

contact_groups.description: Contact group ids to alert (see statuscake_list_contact_groups). An empty list clears them.

tags.description: Tags for the check. An empty list clears them.

paused.description: true to pause the check (stops running and alerting), false to resume.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the first byte, 5-75 (default 15).

trigger_rate.description: Minutes to wait before sending an alert, 0-60 (default 0).

confirmation.description: Number of confirmation servers that must agree before alerting, 0-3 (default 2).

regions.description: Region codes to run the check from (see statuscake_list_uptime_locations).

find_string.description: String to look for in the response; the check is down if not found.

do_not_find.description: Invert find_string: the check is down if the string IS present.

include_header.description: Include response headers in the find_string search.

follow_redirects.description: Follow redirects when testing (off by default).

final_endpoint.description: Where the redirect chain should end (with follow_redirects).

status_codes_csv.description: Comma-separated HTTP status codes that count as down, e.g. "500,502,503".

enable_ssl_alert.description: Alert when the site's SSL certificate is about to expire.

user_agent.description: Custom User-Agent sent with each check.

custom_header.description: JSON object string of headers to send, e.g. {"X-Env":"prod"}.

post_body.description: JSON object string submitted with the request; setting it makes the check use HTTP POST.

post_raw.description: Raw HTTP POST body to send.

basic_username.description: HTTP basic-auth username for the target.

basic_password.description: HTTP basic-auth password for the target.

dns_ips.description: IP addresses the DNS record must resolve to (DNS checks).

tools.name: statuscake_update_uptime_check
tools.title: Update an uptime check
tools.description: Change an uptime check's settings. Only the fields you pass are changed; list fields (tags, contact_groups, regions, dns_ips) are REPLACED, and an empty list clears them. Pass paused=true to pause a check and paused=false to resume it. StatusCake: PUT /uptime/{test_id}.

website_url.description: New URL, FQDN or IP address to check.

contact_groups.description: Contact group ids to alert (see statuscake_list_contact_groups). An empty list clears them.

tags.description: Tags for the check. An empty list clears them.

paused.description: true to pause the check (stops running and alerting), false to resume.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the first byte, 5-75 (default 15).

trigger_rate.description: Minutes to wait before sending an alert, 0-60 (default 0).

confirmation.description: Number of confirmation servers that must agree before alerting, 0-3 (default 2).

regions.description: Region codes to run the check from (see statuscake_list_uptime_locations).

find_string.description: String to look for in the response; the check is down if not found.

do_not_find.description: Invert find_string: the check is down if the string IS present.

include_header.description: Include response headers in the find_string search.

follow_redirects.description: Follow redirects when testing (off by default).

final_endpoint.description: Where the redirect chain should end (with follow_redirects).

status_codes_csv.description: Comma-separated HTTP status codes that count as down, e.g. "500,502,503".

enable_ssl_alert.description: Alert when the site's SSL certificate is about to expire.

user_agent.description: Custom User-Agent sent with each check.

custom_header.description: JSON object string of headers to send, e.g. {"X-Env":"prod"}.

post_body.description: JSON object string submitted with the request; setting it makes the check use HTTP POST.

post_raw.description: Raw HTTP POST body to send.

basic_username.description: HTTP basic-auth username for the target.

basic_password.description: HTTP basic-auth password for the target.

dns_ips.description: IP addresses the DNS record must resolve to (DNS checks).

tools.name: statuscake_create_ssl_check
tools.title: Create an SSL check
tools.description: Start monitoring a site's SSL certificate for expiry and problems. Returns the new id as data.new_id. StatusCake: POST /ssl.

website_url.description: URL of the server under test; must begin with https://.

alert_at.description: Exactly three day counts before expiry at which to alert, e.g. [30, 7, 1].

alert_expiry.description: Alert when the certificate is about to expire.

alert_broken.description: Alert when certificate problems are found.

alert_mixed.description: Alert when mixed content is found.

contact_groups.description: Contact group ids to alert (see statuscake_list_contact_groups). An empty list clears them.

follow_redirects.description: Follow redirects when testing (off by default).

hostname.description: Hostname of the server under test, if different from the URL.

tools.name: statuscake_create_heartbeat_check
tools.title: Create a heartbeat check
tools.description: Create a heartbeat (push) check for a cron job or worker: it goes down if StatusCake is not pinged within `period` seconds. Returns the new id as data.new_id; fetch it with statuscake_get_heartbeat_check to get the ping URL. StatusCake: POST /heartbeat.

period.description: Seconds since the last ping before the check is down, 30-172800 (e.g. 1800).

contact_groups.description: Contact group ids to alert (see statuscake_list_contact_groups). An empty list clears them.

tags.description: Tags for the check. An empty list clears them.

tools.name: statuscake_create_maintenance_window
tools.title: Create a maintenance window
tools.description: Schedule a maintenance window that silences alerts for the given uptime checks (by id and/or tag). start_at/end_at are RFC3339; only the date and time are used and are read as local time in `timezone`. At least one of tests or tags is required. Only works on accounts using the newer maintenance-windows feature. StatusCake: POST /maintenance-windows.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the times are read in, e.g. UTC or Europe/London.

repeat_interval.description: How often it repeats: never, 1d, 1w, 2w or 1m.

tags.description: Include every uptime check carrying these tags.
